summary: Gallery performance fix verified. Page load (loadEventEnd - navigationStart) = 1.87s, well under 3s target. All 119 items render with '119 Photos' header. Images now served from /assets/gallery_webp/*.webp at ~38-44 KB each (content-type image/webp). tags include width=480, height=480, loading=lazy, decoding=async. Old PNG path no longer serves image (SPA fallback returns index.html instead of the PNG binary - file effectively removed).
critical_code_review_comments: Old /assets/gallery/*.png returns HTTP 200 with text/html (SPA index.html fallback) instead of 404. Not a functional issue since gallery no longer references PNGs, but if strict 404 semantics are desired, static file 404 handling could be added at the server/CDN level.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Perf iteration complete. Gallery loads in ~1.87s, WebP images 38-44 KB. All acceptance criteria met.
